Scope: WP6 explicitly named real runtime gates on a runner-owned isolated database; required-case and application/recovery evidence are bound separately.
SourceState: WP6 runner task source; applicable source-file and runtime-binary hashes required

Checks.Name: Isolation.Wp3Owner
Checks.Detail: Dedicated loopback WP6 name, role, provider and owner verified.

Checks.Name: Installation.CoreExactHistory
Checks.Detail: Exact Core history=1, pending=0; no full catalog or business acceptance implied.

Checks.Name: Locks.TransactionLifecycle
Checks.Detail: Two native sessions: same-key zero/finite contention, usable transaction after busy timeout, distinct tenant key, commit/rollback/dispose release, cancellation then rollback and fresh transaction. Primitive resource namespaces only; full business isolation remains separate.

Checks.Name: Locks.SessionLifecycle
Checks.Detail: Two native sessions: contention and canceled wait, two actual committed batches retain the lock, explicit release/Dispose are idempotent, peer reacquires and releases, both non-owned connections remain open and usable.

Checks.Name: Clock.AdvancingDatabaseUtc
Checks.Detail: Two UTC Kind reads advanced in one native transaction and matched independent clock_timestamp bounds; transaction_timestamp stayed fixed. No application-clock input or business-date conversion.
